CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.permission_profile_revision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 NEW.permission_revision := nextval('permission_editor_revision_seq');
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

permission_user_assignment_revision

trigger_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pin_sent_attachment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO sent_asset_attachments(tenant_id,asset_id,attachment_id)
 SELECT NEW.tenant_id,NEW.job_id,NEW.attachment_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sent_mail_assets WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.job_id)
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
trigger_functions.name: pin_sent_attachment

trigger_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_mail_template_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.id,NEW.tenant_id,NEW.template_id,NEW.version,NEW.snapshot,NEW.content_hash,NEW.published_by,NEW.published_at)
 IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id,OLD.tenant_id,OLD.template_id,OLD.version,OLD.snapshot,OLD.content_hash,OLD.published_by,OLD.published_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'published template content is immutable';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
trigger_functions.name: protect_mail_template_version

trigger_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_sent_asset()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF OLD.recipient_completeness='legacy_unknown' AND OLD.bcc_addrs IS NULL AND OLD.recipient_snapshot_version=0
  AND NEW.recipient_completeness='complete' AND NEW.bcc_addrs IS NOT NULL AND NEW.recipient_snapshot_version=1
  AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['bcc_addrs','recipient_completeness','recipient_snapshot_version'])
    =(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['bcc_addrs','recipient_completeness','recipient_snapshot_version'])
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbound_jobs j WHERE j.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND j.id=OLD.id
   AND sent_recipient_source_matches_v1(OLD,j)
   AND NEW.bcc_addrs IS NOT DISTINCT FROM j.bcc_addrs)
 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'sent mail content is immutable';
END $function$
trigger_functions.name: protect_sent_asset
